parsed.internal_thinking: Hadar is offering 2 Sheep for 1 Wood. While 2:1 is a generous ratio, I currently only have 1 Wood and I produce it on a low-probability roll (11). I am currently at node 43 and have roads leading to node 50, where I plan to build my next settlement. To build that settlement, I need 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Sheep, and 1 Wheat. I already have 1 Wood, 1 Sheep, and 2 Wheat. I only need 1 Brick. If I trade away my only Wood for more Sheep, I will be further from my goal because I'll then need both Wood and Brick. Therefore, I will reject the trade to keep my Wood for my own expansion.
parsed.note_to_self: I am 1 Brick away from a settlement at node 50 (Ore 5, Wheat 9, 3:1 port). I should try to trade one of my Wheat for a Brick on my turn or Ziv's turn. Hadar is at 3 VP and has good Brick production, so she is a potential trade partner for Brick later.
